name: digital-clock
description: A digital clock widget that displays your system time in real time.

config.name: hide_seconds
config.label: Hide Seconds
config.description: When enabled, the seconds portion of the clock is not displayed.

config.name: hide_suffix
config.label: Hide AM / PM
config.description: When enabled, the AM/PM suffix is hidden. Only applies when using 12-hour format.

config.name: no_leading_zero
config.label: No leading hour zero
config.description: When enabled, a leading zero is not added to single-digit hours (e.g. '9:00' instead of '09:00').

config.name: text_color
config.label: Text Color
config.description: The color of the clock text.

config.name: font_family
config.label: Font
config.description: The font family used to render the clock text.

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size of the clock text in pixels.

config.name: align_horizontal
config.label: Align Horizontal
config.description: Controls the horizontal alignment of the clock within the widget.

config.name: align_vertical
config.label: Align Vertical
config.description: Controls the vertical alignment of the clock within the widget.
